'''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Good afternoon. I desperately need the staff keycards from the TerraGroup laboratory, and you know full well how impossible it is to get even one of those. I heard that Mechanic is willing to trade the cards for some military equipment, but I lack the manpower to gather it currently. This is a matter of life and death. Will you help?}}

==Objectives==
*Hand over a [[TerraGroup Labs access keycard]]
*Hand over a [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Violet)]]
*Hand over a [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Yellow)]]
*Hand over a [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Red)]]
*Hand over a [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Green)]]
*Hand over a [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Blue)]]
*Hand over a [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)]]

==Rewards==
* [[Therapist]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.15'''</font>
* 5× [[26x75mm flare cartridge (Acid Green)]]
* 5× [[M.U.L.E. stimulant injector]]
* 5× [[eTG-change regenerative stimulant injector]]
* 5× [[SJ1 TGLabs combat stimulant injector]]
* 5× [[SJ6 TGLabs combat stimulant injector]]
* Unlocks barter for [[26x75mm flare cartridge (Acid Green)]] at [[Therapist]] LL1
* Unlocks achievement [[Achievements#Event_achievements|A Key to Salvation]]
{{Quote|Thank you! I don't know how or where you got them, but now I can get the equipment that will surely delight my cust— Ahem, patients, of course. These cards are the key to salvation no less!}}

The [[Keys_%26_Intel#The_Lab|keycards]] can be bartered from [[Mechanic]] LL1 for a various number of [[6-STEN-140-M military battery|6-STEN-140-M military batteries]].

The batteries have 3 guaranteed spawns on [[Customs]] each raid:
*On the roof of the three-story dorms building
*Inside the new gas station
*On the second floor of the Scav base (ZB-013 extraction) building

Each location is defended by [[Scav Raiders]].
